title.narrative: Strengthening Electoral Processes and Political Accountability

description.narrative: The Strengthening Electoral Processes and Political Accountability activity aims to build government capacity to respond to strategic priorities, facilitate improved election administration and oversight, and strengthen institutions of political accountability for sustained political competition in Armenia.
